_comment: Registry for the ecosystem dev-script sync (distribute_scripts.py, ADR D-013; vendored layout ADR D-014). The canonical sources are the 'src' paths under kriegerdataforge-cicd/scripts/common/; each is vendored byte-identical to every repo in 'repos' at its 'dest' path under scripts/kdf_scripts/ -- a vendor directory that every tenant's kdf-fmt.toml and ruff config EXCLUDES, so cicd alone governs the style of what it ships. 'deletes' are superseded paths removed by the same sync PR (the pre-1.1.0 flat scripts/ layout). 'makefile_patch' rewrites script paths + the canonical ci-version-check recipe; 'kdf_fmt_patch' appends the vendor-dir exclude to kdf-fmt.toml; a repo's optional 'ruff_config' names the file (ruff.toml or pyproject.toml) that gets the same exclude. check mode reports drift; distribute mode opens one PR per drifted repo (never auto-merges). See docs/features/version-scripts-sync.md.
_excluded_notes: kriegerdataforge-cicd is the SOURCE — its scripts/common/ copies ARE the canonical, so it is not a sync target (no self-PRs; its own Makefile calls scripts/common/check_version.py directly and its kdf-fmt config governs the canonical style). Unlike the kit registry this one INCLUDES kriegerdataforge-fmt. The 4 template repos are included so a /generate'd repo is born with current scripts AND the vendor-dir excludes. Per-repo scripts/version_targets.json manifests are NOT synced and deliberately stay OUTSIDE scripts/kdf_scripts/ (tenant-owned config, see version_targets.py). A scripts-sync PR does not bump VERSION: the central scripts/common/check_version.py exempts PRs that touch only these dest+delete paths (plus Makefile / kdf-fmt.toml / ruff.toml / pyproject.toml, on chore/scripts-sync-* branches only) — ADR D-013, mirroring the kit's ADR D-001 option B.
